log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error

model_path.description: Path to the input data model file (e.g., .er, .erx, or .xml format)

targets.description: List of data model generation targets (e.g., SQL DDL generation specifications). Each entry defines a target database schema and output path.

targets.items.description: A single data model generation target configuration. All fields are optional and used only when present.

targets.items.name.description: Human-readable name for the target configuration

targets.items.output_dir.description: Directory path where generated output files will be written
